newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-RAPID TRAINER SACKED OVER POOR RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RAPID TRAINER SACKED OVER POOR RESULTS.

text.p: Romanian first division side Rapid sacked trainer Ion Dumitru on Wednesday following a string of poor results and replaced him with former Rapid defender Forin Marin.
"Rapid invested a lot of money to bring in good players during the winter break, but the team's results have been far from expectations," club president Grigore Sichitiu said.
The Bucharest-based team are currently seventh in the first division standings.
Florin Marin previously trained first division Ceahlaul Piatra Neamt.
